response.rationale: R1 best fits the lichenoid morphology and bandlike lymphocytic infiltrate; R2-R4 explain follicular keratotic plugs but not the steroid-responsive pruritic inflammatory pattern or lichenoid histopathology.

rejected.why: Follicular keratotic plugs are present, but the bandlike lymphocytic infiltrate and steroid-responsive pruritic papules are not explained by lichen spinulosus.
Keratosis pilaris typically affects extensor surfaces and lacks the bandlike dermal infiltrate and epidermal atrophy.
Phrynoderma requires nutritional deficiency and shows follicular hyperkeratosis without the lichenoid infiltrate or steroid response.
